coverage_gaps: PubMed-only routing may miss non-indexed historical records, preprints, regulatory documents, datasets, and full-text details unavailable from abstracts.
Some early reports may use PARK8 or dardarin without modern LRRK2 terminology and may require citation chaining beyond the planned lexical queries.
Direct physiological-substrate evidence in human brain and disease-relevant neurons may remain sparse relative to evidence from peripheral cells, engineered systems, or animal models.
Penetrance and effect-size estimates may remain imprecise for rare variants and underrepresented ancestries.
Mechanistic findings from strongly activating variants such as G2019S may not generalize to ROC-COR variants, risk alleles, protective haplotypes, or sporadic Parkinson disease.
exclusion_criteria: Articles lacking substantive data or analysis about LRRK2 genetics, enzymology, substrates, physiology, or Parkinson disease.
Variant catalogues without interpretable disease association, segregation, functional evidence, or population context.
Substrate claims based only on overexpression or a single non-orthogonal assay when no direct or endogenous validation is provided; such records may be retained solely as disputed evidence.
Therapeutic efficacy studies that do not inform target mechanism, substrate engagement, safety-related biology, or causal interpretation.
Non-Parkinson disease findings with no explicit relevance to LRRK2 mechanism or physiological context.
Duplicate reports of the same cohort or experiment unless they add longer follow-up, independent analysis, or materially new mechanistic evidence.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed-indexed records published on or before 2024-12-31.
Primary human genetic studies supporting linkage, segregation, association, penetrance, ancestry effects, or protection, with foundational discovery reports retained regardless of cohort size.
Biochemical or structural studies that directly measure LRRK2 kinase or GTPase behavior, variant effects, or inhibitor-sensitive signaling.
Substrate studies that demonstrate direct phosphorylation or provide endogenous genetic, pharmacological, phosphosite, or orthogonal validation.
Cellular, animal, and human-biospecimen studies that connect LRRK2 activity or validated substrates to Parkinson-relevant physiology or pathology.
Systematic reviews or meta-analyses used for terminology expansion, replication context, and synthesis, while preserving links to the primary evidence.
Studies reporting null, conflicting, context-dependent, or mechanism-limiting findings.

queries.purpose: Identify original linkage, positional-cloning, and familial segregation reports establishing the LRRK2-Parkinson disease association.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract] OR dardarin[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract])) AND (linkage[Title/Abstract] OR pedigree*[Title/Abstract] OR segregation[Title/Abstract] OR discover*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence for major pathogenic variants, including segregation, ancestry, clinical phenotype, and functional consequences.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract])) AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441C[Title/Abstract] OR R1441G[Title/Abstract] OR R1441H[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract] OR N1437H[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture population-specific risk alleles and protective variants or haplotypes that broaden the allelic spectrum beyond highly penetrant mutations.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR PARK8[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract])) AND (G2385R[Title/Abstract] OR R1628P[Title/Abstract] OR N551K[Title/Abstract] OR R1398H[Title/Abstract] OR "risk variant"[Title/Abstract] OR protective[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm penetrance estimates and test their dependence on age, ancestry, ascertainment, and study design.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR G2019S[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH Terms] OR Parkinson*[Title/Abstract])) AND (penetrance[Title/Abstract] OR age-dependent[Title/Abstract] OR ancestry[Title/Abstract] OR population[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Publication Type])

queries.purpose: Map the dual kinase-GTPase architecture and variant-dependent effects on enzymatic state.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (kinase[Title/Abstract] OR GTPase[Title/Abstract] OR ROC[Title/Abstract] OR COR[Title/Abstract] OR autophosphorylation[Title/Abstract]) AND (mechanism*[Title/Abstract] OR activat*[Title/Abstract] OR pathogenic[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Compare biochemical effects across disease-associated variants and test whether increased kinase signaling is shared or variant-specific.
queries.query: (LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (G2019S[Title/Abstract] OR R1441*[Title/Abstract] OR Y1699C[Title/Abstract] OR I2020T[Title/Abstract])) AND ("kinase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR "GTPase activity"[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylation[Title/Abstract] OR inhibitor*[Title/Abstract] OR "kinase-dead"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify discovery studies nominating Rab proteins as LRRK2 substrates and define reported phosphorylation sites.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract] OR "Rab GTPase"[Title/Abstract]) AND (substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphoproteom*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphosite*[Title/Abstract] OR phosphorylat*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Assess physiological substrate validation using endogenous systems, genetics, pharmacology, human biospecimens, and orthogonal assays.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (Rab8A[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR Rab12[Title/Abstract]) AND (endogenous[Title/Abstract] OR physiological[Title/Abstract] OR validation[Title/Abstract] OR knock-in[Title/Abstract] OR knockout[Title/Abstract] OR inhibitor*[Title/Abstract] OR human[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Connect LRRK2-Rab signaling to proposed cellular functions and Parkinson-relevant organelle phenotypes.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (lysosom*[Title/Abstract] OR autophag*[Title/Abstract] OR endolysosomal[Title/Abstract] OR vesicle*[Title/Abstract] OR trafficking[Title/Abstract] OR cili*[Title/Abstract] OR mitochondri*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Rab*[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract] OR phosphor*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Examine cell-type and tissue context, including immune cells and dopaminergic neurons, to bound physiological generality.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND (microglia[Title/Abstract] OR macrophage*[Title/Abstract] OR monocyte*[Title/Abstract] OR immune[Title/Abstract] OR inflammation[Title/Abstract] OR "dopaminergic neuron"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR kinase[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve evidence that challenges a uniform kinase-centered mechanism, including incomplete penetrance, model limitations, variable neurodegeneration, and familial-to-sporadic extrapolation.
queries.query: LRRK2[Title/Abstract] AND Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] AND (conflict*[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR heterogeneity[Title/Abstract] OR "incomplete penetrance"[Title/Abstract] OR sporadic[Title/Abstract] OR knockout[Title/Abstract] OR knock-in[Title/Abstract] OR "animal model"[Title/Abstract] OR "human tissue"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Capture recent genetic, mechanistic, substrate-validation, biomarker, and synthesis evidence through the specified cutoff.
queries.query: ((LRRK2[Title/Abstract] OR "leucine-rich repeat kinase 2"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Parkinson*[Title/Abstract] OR Rab10[Title/Abstract] OR substrate*[Title/Abstract] OR penetrance[Title/Abstract])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

question_frame: Using PubMed-indexed evidence available through 2024-12-31, trace how LRRK2 was genetically linked to Parkinson disease, distinguish pathogenic, risk-associated, protective, and population-specific variants, explain kinase and GTPase mechanisms and physiological substrates, and assess evidence that supports or limits causal generalization across variants, models, tissues, and sporadic disease.
stop_rules: Stop foundational genetic searching after the original PARK8 linkage and LRRK2 cloning reports plus independent evidence covering major pathogenic, risk-associated, protective, and population-specific variant classes are represented.

Stop variant-mechanism searching when each major domain class has either direct enzymatic evidence or an explicit evidence gap and additional query refinements yield no new variant-mechanism category.
Stop substrate searching only after discovery evidence and at least two distinct validation modes are represented for the principal physiological substrate family.
Stop pathway expansion after lysosomal or vesicular biology, mitochondrial or ciliary biology, immune context, and dopaminergic-neuron relevance are each represented or documented as gaps.
Stop the challenge wave after evidence addresses penetrance, variant heterogeneity, model dependence, human-tissue support, and limits on extrapolation to sporadic Parkinson disease.
Stop all retrieval after the update query is screened and two consecutive query refinements add no new eligible evidence category, mechanistic contradiction, or material qualification.
Do not stop solely because a dominant kinase-centered narrative is saturated; retain null and conflicting evidence needed to assess strength and generality.
